signature.name: VTask.lifts
signature.type: {ι : Type u_1} -> {R : Type u_4} -> [CommSemiring R] -> {s : ι → Type u_7} -> [(i : ι) → AddCommMonoid (s i)] -> [(i : ι) → Module R (s i)] -> (x : PiTensorProduct R fun i => s i) -> Set (FreeAddMonoid (R × ((i : ι) → s i)))

conventions.note: NONE_DECLARED: The definition is total and well-defined for every element x of the tensor product, with no junk-value conventions needed.

facts.statement: ∀ {ι : Type*} {R : Type*} [CommSemiring R] {s : ι → Type*} [∀ i, AddCommMonoid (s i)] [∀ i, Module R (s i)] (x y : PiTensorProduct R fun i => s i) (p q : FreeAddMonoid (R × ((i : ι) → s i))), p ∈ VTask.lifts x → q ∈ VTask.lifts y → p + q ∈ VTask.lifts (x + y)
